verdict.rationale: Marlin is documented only as a one-off autonomous research run: you give it a topic and it works for up to about eight hours, then delivers a report and slides. Nothing in the evidence shows user-configurable standing searches, recurring schedules or alerts that surface new sources as they appear. The 'fresh, up-to-date information' claim describes a single run, and Marlin Insights is Sakana's own published research rather than a user alert feature.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can set up standing searches or alerts that surface new relevant sources as they appear
